narration: Your old debt legally died. The statute of limitations ran out — collectors can't sue you. But here's the thing: it can rise from the dead.
visual: Dark background. A tombstone labeled 'DEBT $4,200' rises from the ground, cracks form, glowing red eyes appear. Hook text overlay: 'YOUR DEBT ISN'T DEAD'.

narration: Debt collectors buy your expired debt for one to four cents on the dollar. An $4,200 debt? They paid maybe eighty bucks for it. Then they come for the full amount.
visual: Light background. SVG dollar bill labeled '$4,200' being sold with a price tag showing '$84'. Stack of files/folders representing debt portfolios. Counter animating from $0 to $88B label showing market size.

narration: Here's the trap. One payment — even five dollars — legally resets the clock. Suddenly you owe again, for another three to seven years. That's zombie debt.
visual: Dark background. A calendar resets from year 7 back to year 1 with a red reset arrow. Clock hand spinning backward. Warning label 'CLOCK RESETS' in bold red flashing text.

narration: They'll call at odd hours, use fake urgency, say 'just pay a little to show good faith.' Don't. That phrase is designed to resurrect your liability.
visual: Light background. SVG phone ringing with red vibration lines. Speech bubble showing 'Just pay $5 to show good faith!' with a red X over it. Person silhouette backing away from phone.

narration: Here's how you protect yourself: never acknowledge the debt verbally. Ask for everything in writing. Request debt validation within thirty days — it's your legal right.
visual: Dark background. SVG shield with a checkmark. Three numbered steps appearing one by one: '1. Don't acknowledge', '2. Request writing', '3. Demand validation'. Each step springs in with animation.

narration: The FDCPA gives you real power. If they break the rules, you can sue them. Know your rights — zombie debt dies permanently when you stop being scared of it.
visual: Light background. SVG document labeled 'FDCPA' with a shield icon. Text: 'YOUR RIGHTS' in large bold. Tombstone with 'ZOMBIE DEBT' crumbling to dust. CTA: 'Check your state's statute of limitations'.
